description: Utility functions for handling posts in Mattermost, including message formatting, permission checks, URL construction, and mention processing.

methods.name: isSystemMessage
methods.description: Checks if a post is a system message based on its type prefix.

methods.name: fromAutoResponder
methods.description: Checks if a post is an auto-responder message.

methods.name: isFromWebhook
methods.description: Checks if a post originates from a webhook.

methods.name: isFromBot
methods.description: Checks if a post originates from a bot.

methods.name: isPostOwner
methods.description: Determines if the current user is the owner of the post.

methods.name: isComment
methods.description: Checks if a post is a comment (reply) based on root_id.

methods.name: isEdited
methods.description: Checks if a post has been edited.

methods.name: getImageSrc
methods.description: Constructs the image URL, optionally using an image proxy.

methods.name: canDeletePost
methods.description: Determines if the current user can delete the post.

methods.name: canEditPost
methods.description: Determines if the current user can edit the post.

methods.name: shouldShowDotMenu
methods.description: Decides if the dot menu should be shown for a post.

methods.name: shouldShowActionsMenu
methods.description: Decides if the actions menu should be shown for a post.

methods.name: containsAtChannel
methods.description: Checks if the text contains an @channel or similar mention.

methods.name: specialMentionsInText
methods.description: Detects special mentions like @all, @channel, @here in text.

methods.name: groupsMentionedInText
methods.description: Returns groups mentioned in the text.

methods.name: shouldFocusMainTextbox
methods.description: Determines if the main textbox should be focused based on keyboard event.

methods.name: canAutomaticallyCloseBackticks
methods.description: Checks if backticks can be auto-closed in message.

methods.name: isWithinCodeBlock
methods.description: Checks if caret is within a code block in message.

methods.name: sendOnCtrlEnter
methods.description: Handles message sending logic on Ctrl+Enter.

methods.name: postMessageOnKeyPress
methods.description: Handles key press events for message posting.

methods.name: isServerError
methods.description: Type guard to check if error is a ServerError.

methods.name: isErrorInvalidSlashCommand
methods.description: Checks if error is related to an invalid slash command.

methods.name: isIdNotPost
methods.description: Checks if an ID is not a post ID.

methods.name: getOldestPostId
methods.description: Returns the oldest valid post ID from a list.

methods.name: getPreviousPostId
methods.description: Returns the previous post ID relative to a start index.

methods.name: getLatestPostId
methods.description: Returns the latest valid post ID from a list.

methods.name: makeGetMentionsFromMessage
methods.description: Creates a selector to extract mentions from a post message.

methods.name: usePostAriaLabel
methods.description: React hook to generate ARIA label for a post.

methods.name: createAriaLabelForPost
methods.description: Constructs ARIA label string for accessibility.

methods.name: splitMessageBasedOnCaretPosition
methods.description: Splits message at caret position.

methods.name: splitMessageBasedOnTextSelection
methods.description: Splits message based on text selection.

methods.name: areConsecutivePostsBySameUser
methods.description: Checks if two posts are by the same user within a time window.

methods.name: hasAiGeneratedMetadata
methods.description: Checks if a post has AI-generated metadata.

methods.name: getPostURL
methods.description: Constructs permalink URL for a post.

methods.name: matchUserMentionTriggersWithMessageMentions
methods.description: Checks if user mention triggers match message mentions.

methods.name: makeGetUniqueReactionsToPost
methods.description: Selector to get unique reactions to a post.

methods.name: makeGetUniqueEmojiNameReactionsForPost
methods.description: Selector to get unique emoji names reacted to a post.

methods.name: makeGetIsReactionAlreadyAddedToPost
methods.description: Selector to check if current user already reacted with an emoji.

methods.name: getPotentialMentionsForName
methods.description: Generates potential mention strings by trimming punctuation.

methods.name: getMentionDetails
methods.description: Retrieves user or group details from mention name.

methods.name: getUserOrGroupFromMentionName
methods.description: Gets user or group from mention name, with priority to user.

methods.name: mentionsMinusSpecialMentionsInText
methods.description: Returns mentions excluding special mentions.

methods.name: makeGetUserOrGroupMentionCountFromMessage
methods.description: Selector to count mentions in message.

methods.name: hasRequestedPersistentNotifications
methods.description: Checks if post priority requests persistent notifications.

methods.name: getPostTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves translation data for a post based on locale.

methods.name: getPostTranslatedMessage
methods.description: Returns translated message if available.
